criteria.reason: The handoff records redundant copying, a custom verifier whose bookkeeping triggered repeated runs, and a commit solely to record the previous hash. These operations added avoidable copying, verification and hook work without new information or a material uncertainty. Retaining the review and gate evidence once, linking it from the current state, and reporting the delivery hash in the retained final response would preserve the same evidence.

evidence.quote: P1 unchanged. Created a custom manifest-of-manifests verifier, copied the same review and gate output into three new directories, and reran it because recording each successful verification changed another manifest.
Then made an evidence-only commit solely to store the previous commit hash and reran its hook; no new check or requirement was established.
R1 independently verified on unchanged payload P1; local gate passed.
